specs.Camera-wiki: Canon Sure Shot Del Sol/Prima Sol/Autoboy SE
specs.英文简介: A March 1995 model from Canon's very successful Sure Shot range, the Sure Shot Del Sol - known as the Prima Sol in continental Europe and Autoboy SE in Japan - was the world's first camera using solar energy for all its power requirements.[http://global.canon/en/c-museum/product/film178.html Canon Camera Museum] Its front is covered with a solar panel that recharges an internal lithium ion battery
